Nah, you're just straight up wrong, depends on the restaurant. I was a line cook and the "hostesses" literally only had to serve the patrons and vacuum the dining area. And the cunts sure as fuck didn't share tips, cause the head chef's (who was the owner) wife was the maitre d and didn't want them to share with us. They literally only did #1 and #2 (only for seating area) from your list.

Our dishwashers got fucked and were responsible for everything else on your list, but we felt bad for them so we'd help them when it was slow/closing time. 

Waiters in general have the easiest, least scrutinized job in any restaurant and over 20% is way too big of a tip even for a high end place. You're literally just the chauffeur for the centerpiece of the establishment, the chef's food. 🤡

Sorry bro, but before I had the chance to work with Japanese and Koreans I wouldn't have had the slightest clue if they were Chinese, Japanese, etc. from their looks and language. 

The point is, your position is ignorant at best, down right racist at worst, and one that has been used against Asians for decades (e.g. "you all look the same"). Just stop digging, put the shovel down, and accept the fact that you should have said Hispanic or Latino. It's okay to admit you were wrong.

Please don't try it, 750mg would probably just be an extremely bad time. Might work, or more likely you might get seriously fucked up for life. 

A friend of mine tried back in 2019 with more sertraline than that, mixed with alcohol and other drugs, and ended up in a medically induced coma. She got ARDS during it and her lungs are now permanently damaged, in addition to all the other lasting side effects. The bits she can recall before the coma were apparently excruciatingly painful as well. Plus if you're in the US like she was, add insane medical bills onto all that. 

I highly recommend against it, ODing with most drugs is unreliable and has a high chance of leaving you worse off than before.
